arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْراً مِنْهَا.
transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon, Allahumma'jurnee fee museebatee wa akhlif lee khayran minhaa.
translation: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
